page_title: UDI 2-1 LAZ | Udinese v Lazio 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' 2 - 1 Goal! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
90+4' Close! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
90+4' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
86' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
83' Here is a change. Lorenzo Lucca is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Keinan Davis (Udinese).
82' Substitution. Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) has come on for Mattia Zaccagni.
82' The game has come to an end for Adam Marusic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
80' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
76' Substitution. Florian Thauvin leaves the pitch and is replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
75' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Christian Kabasele (Udinese) replaces Lautaro Giannetti.
73' Lazio enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
68' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) receives a yellow card, which wouldn't be so bad if it wasn't his second one today! Logically, a red card follows and the game is over for him.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) replaces Brenner.
66' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Martin Payero is replaced by Sandi Lovric (Udinese).
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
64' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
64' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
62' Martin Payero (Udinese) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
60' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) replacing Tijjani Noslin.
60' The referee signals a substitution. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Fisayo Dele-Bashiru.
60' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.

56' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
55' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
55' Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
54' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
53' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Lazio have a corner.
49' 2 - 0 Florian Thauvin (Udinese) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Ivan Provedel with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
49' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Doveri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' Substitution. Nicolo Casale makes way for Patric (Lazio).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and it's Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+3' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' That's unlucky! Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
39' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up an injury.
32' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.

30' What an amazing save by Ivan Provedel! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the left side of the target, but fails.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
25' Close! Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
23' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
19' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Taty Castellanos (Lazio) but poses no threat.
17' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
17' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
15' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
13' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' A clumsy foul by Jaka Bijol (Udinese) and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Florian Thauvin is the provider and Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the right of the goal from close in with his head. 1:0.
7' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Daniele Doveri wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
5' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
5' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
